title: Musher Blueprint Document
description: A composition of one or more components into a single deployable application.
$comment: Seeded from the platform's generated catalog schema. Structural and type validation only — cross-document reference resolution, slug/directory agreement, and platform capability checks are separate validation layers. See spec.md.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Must be BLUEPRINT.

specVersion.title: Specversion
specVersion.description: Version of the seed authoring document format.

BlueprintComputeConstraintsRequest.title: BlueprintComputeConstraintsRequest
BlueprintComputeConstraintsRequest.description: Advanced, optional compute pins (ADR 0041) honored by Placement (ADR 0095).

acceleratorInterconnect.title: Acceleratorinterconnect
acceleratorInterconnect.description: Required interconnect such as 'nvlink' or 'pcie', or null for any.

acceleratorMinVramGb.title: Acceleratorminvramgb
acceleratorMinVramGb.description: Minimum accelerator VRAM in GiB, or null for no floor.

acceleratorRuntime.title: Acceleratorruntime
acceleratorRuntime.description: Required accelerator runtimes, e.g. ['cuda']. Empty means any.

acceleratorSkuClass.title: Acceleratorskuclass
acceleratorSkuClass.description: Exact accelerator SKU class to pin, or null.

cpuArchitecture.title: Cpuarchitecture
cpuArchitecture.description: Allowed CPU architectures, e.g. ['x86_64', 'arm64']. Empty means any.

cpuDedication.title: Cpudedication
cpuDedication.description: CPU dedication: 'shared' or 'dedicated', or null for the platform default.

networkClass.title: Networkclass
networkClass.description: Required network class such as 'standard', or null for the default.

storageClass.title: Storageclass
storageClass.description: Required storage class such as 'local-nvme', or null for the default.

storageMinIops.title: Storageminiops
storageMinIops.description: Minimum provisioned IOPS, or null for no floor.

BlueprintConnectionRefRequest.title: BlueprintConnectionRefRequest
BlueprintConnectionRefRequest.description:
A consumer-anchored wire (map value; keyed by the consumer input key).

The value names only the producer end (``fromRole`` / ``fromOutput``); the
consumer end is derived from the enclosing node (``toRole`` = the node name)
and the map key (``toInput``). One wire per consumer input (inbound-uniqueness,
enforced by the publish gate).

fromOutput.title: Fromoutput
fromOutput.description: Declared output key on the producer component.

fromRole.title: Fromrole
fromRole.description: Node name of the producer component.

byteLength.title: Bytelength
byteLength.description: Number of random bytes generated for the value.

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: Explicit character set for the generated value, or null when the encoding default is used.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: Encoding applied to the random bytes: HEX, BASE64, BASE64URL, or ALPHANUMERIC.

BlueprintParameterRequest.title: BlueprintParameterRequest
BlueprintParameterRequest.description: An install-form parameter composed at the graph layer (map value; keyed by key).

description.title: Description
description.description: Help text shown beneath the field, or null when none is set.

generator.description: Auto-generation spec when the platform mints the value at deploy time, or null when the deploying user supplies it.

isRequired.title: Isrequired
isRequired.description: True when the deploying user must provide a value before deploying.

schema.description: Data contract of the value: type, format, pattern, enum, default, sensitivity.

ui.description: Presentation metadata for the install form.

BlueprintParameterUiRequest.title: BlueprintParameterUiRequest
BlueprintParameterUiRequest.description: Presentation metadata for an install-form parameter.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label shown on the install form.

BlueprintParameterValueSchemaRequest.title: BlueprintParameterValueSchemaRequest
BlueprintParameterValueSchemaRequest.description: Data contract of an install-form parameter value (JSON-Schema subset).

default.title: Default
default.description: Pre-filled value, or null when the deploying user must supply one.

enum.title: Enum
enum.description: Allowed values when the value is a closed enumeration; empty when unconstrained.

format.title: Format
format.description: Semantic refinement of a STRING value: EMAIL, URI, ENDPOINT_URL, or CONNECTION_STRING; null when unrefined.

isSensitive.title: Issensitive
isSensitive.description: True when the value is secret material: masked in UIs, never echoed back.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression the supplied value must match, or null when unconstrained.

type.title: Type
type.description: Primitive shape of the value: STRING, INTEGER, or BOOLEAN.

SeedBlueprintNodeRequest.title: SeedBlueprintNodeRequest
SeedBlueprintNodeRequest.description:
One graph node (map value keyed by node name) — the seed-local ref form.

The public-wire node (``BlueprintComponentRefRequest``) references a
Component by ``componentId`` + ``componentVersion``; a seed item has no ids
yet, so this node references the sibling ``components/<name>.yaml`` file by
``component`` (its stem) instead. Every other field (``size``,
``advanced``, ``connections``) is the wire model's, reused verbatim — the
field-set relationship is drift-gated in
``tests/unit/seeds/test_catalog_manifest_drift.py``.

advanced.description: Optional advanced compute pins that narrow the eligible-host set at schedule time (ADR 0095).

component.title: Component
component.description: Stem of the sibling components/<name>.yaml file this node deploys. The pinned version comes from that file's metadata.version.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Inbound wires for this node, keyed by the consumer input key each fills (value names the producer role and output; one wire per input).

size.title: Size
size.description: Compute Profile slug bound to this node, such as general.standard.small. Required per node — the Component carries no compute of its own (ADR 0092).

SeedBlueprintSpecRequest.title: SeedBlueprintSpecRequest
SeedBlueprintSpecRequest.description:
The ``spec`` block of a blueprint document — mirrors ``BlueprintSpecRequest``.

``parameters`` empty means the importer derives the install-form parameters
from the graph's merged USER-supplied inputs (the standard path); a
non-empty map is an authored override lowered verbatim.

components.title: Components
components.description: Component references composing the graph, keyed by graph-local node name.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: Authored install-form parameter overrides, keyed by parameter key. Empty means the importer derives parameters from merged USER inputs.

SeedItemMetadata.title: SeedItemMetadata
SeedItemMetadata.description: Identity block shared by the blueprint + listing documents.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Item slug — must equal the item's directory name.

version.title: Version
version.description: Item version — must agree between blueprint.yaml and listing.yaml.
